I have no money to buy fertilizer or improved seeds from the shop, so I will use the seeds I kept from last harvest and rely on the soil as it is. My family will work this plot together using our hoes when the rains come, because we cannot afford to pay workers or buy chemicals. I am too old to do the heavy digging now, but my children and grandchildren help me plant and weed when they are not fishing or working in other fields.
